node.statement: For every homogeneous a in I, the left-inversion relation and the coproduct expansion supplied by lem-stage1-exterior-cohomology give 0=sigma^*(a)+a+sum_{j in J_a} sigma^*(aPrime_j)aDoublePrime_j in A, where aPrime_j and aDoublePrime_j are the positive-degree factors appearing in that external coproduct expansion.
